what_this_receipt_does_not_do: It does not measure anything. Every hash, commit, merge base and tool output in it is either null with a reason or attributed by name to the session that measured it.
It does not mint an identifier. Exactly two pre-allocated ids were used; the CORR record and any KN-* entry are deferred to sessions that can allocate.
It does not close the MD5 lane, and it does not let `blocked` drift into `closed`.
It does not claim any path is new, for either primitive, at any tier, and it records no cryptanalytic improvement of any kind. A passing control is not an improvement.
It does not promote any record to `supported`. The claim ceiling for every record of BATCH-efcae7 is `analyzed`.
It does not read a PASS from tools/check_review_independence.py as more than the tool can check, and it does not read it as nothing.
It does not record an attestation, agreement or approval that was not obtained, and it claims no completion_quorum for anything.
